dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (This seems to be the manuscript Souka mentioned she was revising...)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (However, the table is currently covered in handwritten drafts. Most of the chapters look like snippets recorded in a sudden burst of inspiration; the handwriting is wild and unrestrained...)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (It's on par with a doctor's prescription. Aside from Souka herself, it's likely that no one can make heads or tails of it.)
